front.title: RDAP Extension for Internet Routing Registry (IRR) Objects

abstract.t: The Registration Data Access Protocol (RDAP) is used by Regional Internet Registries (RIRs) and Domain Name Registries (DNRs) to provide access to their resource registration information. The core specifications for RDAP define core object types, but they do not contain objects for the Internet Routing Registry (IRR). This document is intended to address this gap.
